Case Studies

Two initiatives I owned end-to-end as Product Owner, from discovery through measurable business outcomes. Toggle each tab to explore the Situation, Task, Action, and Result.

Omnistudio Migration & Performance Revamp

Caterpillar · Global Discounting Tool · 150+ Dealerships · 4 Regions

The legacy discounting tool managed 8+ discount types across 4 regions for 150 dealerships. Each discount type had 100+ input fields with complex financial constraints. The codebase was redundant and bloated, and a different UI per region/discount combo slowed dealer productivity and approval cycles.
As Product Owner, migrate the entire tool to Salesforce Omnistudio: eliminate technical debt, significantly improve dealer-facing usability, and reduce discount request-to-approval time, backed by a more scalable architecture.
  • ›Ran stakeholder discovery with pricing admins and dealers to surface redundant, counter-intuitive form-filling steps.
  • ›Audited legacy LWC code with the Solution Architect and moved to a declarative, drag-and-drop Omnistudio framework.
  • ›Unified all region/discount forms into a single UI pattern with dynamic, conditional section logic.
  • ›Prioritized the backlog via MoSCoW + Value/Effort analysis and led a 10-person team through 4 delivery phases.
  • ›Managed a phased global rollout, starting with one region to validate feedback before scaling.
Delivered a faster, simpler, and more scalable discounting platform validated by real dealer usage data.
34% ↑ App Performance27% ↓ Approval Time2% ↑ Sales Uplift

Accelerated Onboarding of Direct Sales Team

Caterpillar · New Sales Division · 4 Regions · 3-Month Deadline

Caterpillar launched a new direct sales division that needed immediate access to the global discounting tool. With customer negotiations already underway, the team faced a hard 3-month deadline to get a functional discounting workflow live.
As Product Owner, integrate the new team into the discounting infrastructure within 3 months: role-based access, approval workflows across 4 regions, new email templates, and updated financial accounting logic, so the team could start processing discounts by end of UAT.
  • ›Built a 6-sprint roadmap with a dedicated final sprint for UAT, incident remediation, and stakeholder feedback.
  • ›Flagged a mid-project resource constraint to leadership early and secured additional resources to protect the timeline.
  • ›Armed the QA team with comprehensive edge cases and negative scenarios for every conditional update.
  • ›Ran iterative UAT demos with stakeholders and the sales team as each feature shipped, for real-time feedback.
  • ›Synchronized feature rollout with hands-on training so the team was production-ready the moment features went live.
Delivered on time and stood up a repeatable, scalable framework for onboarding future sales teams.
On-Time in 3 Months15% ↑ Sales Performance4 Regions Live
